subject: 2026-10-17-regions-ai-cybersecurity-expense
text:
Brief says: "Regions expects cybersecurity to increase adjusted noninterest expense 1.5% to 3.5%" (headline) and "Regions Financial, the parent of Regions Bank, expects cybersecurity to increase its adjusted noninterest expense by 1.5% to 3.5% for full-year 2026."
Source says: "For full year 2026, we continue to expect adjusted noninterest expense to be up between 1.5% and 3.5%" and "Full Year Adjusted Noninterest Expense Guidance -- Up 1.5% to 3.5% versus 2025, reflecting ongoing technology and infrastructure investments." The line "that is just investment in cyber security" answered a separate question about the quarter's higher tech spend. (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/16/regions-financial-rf-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/)
Suggested fix: do not tie the 1.5% to 3.5% guidance to cyber. Headline e.g. "Regions CFO says investing in cyber defense is even more critical now". Body: "Regions Financial expects full-year 2026 adjusted noninterest expense to be up between 1.5% and 3.5%, CFO Anil Chadha said on the bank's Oct. 16 earnings call. Asked about peers redirecting tech investment toward cyber risk because of AI, Chadha said cyber defense has always been very critical and is even more heightened now, with meaningful expense, both new and redirected, embedded in the bank's numbers." Add the call transcript as a source (source.mjs reads it). (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc; both quotes confirmed on the page.)
